title: Suspension result
description: applied and changed are true only after a real change of spec.suspend. On a dry run both are false and wouldChange says whether a real run would change it. When spec.suspend already had the requested value nothing is sent (all three false). suspendedAfter is spec.suspend read back from the cluster after a real change (otherwise the value it had); null when the read-back failed (an error with scope verify says why).
